item.title: Module: DuckDB
item.description:
DuckDB is a high-performance embedded analytical database.

DuckDB is embedded, so it does not require deployment or service management. Install the DuckDB package on the node and use it directly.

Installation

The current Pigsty node platform mapping includes the duckdb package. Install it directly from the Infra repository:

./node.yml -t node_install -e '{"node_repo_modules":"infra","node_packages":["duckdb"]}'

Install with pig:

pig repo add infra -u # add Infra repo
pig install duckdb # install DuckDB package

item.title: Module: Kubernetes
item.description:
Kubernetes is a production-grade, open-source container orchestration platform. It helps you automate, deploy, scale, and manage containerized applications.

Pigsty has native support for ETCD clusters, which can be used as external etcd for Kubernetes.

The current open-source tree has no kube.yml playbook, Kubernetes role, or kube_* parameters. Pigsty provides software repositories and base-node provisioning. Use kubeadm, SealOS, or another Kubernetes tool for cluster initialization, networking, control-plane management, and upgrades.

SealOS

SealOS is a lightweight, high-performance Kubernetes distribution. It simplifies Kubernetes cluster deployment and management.

item.title: Module: Consul
item.description:
Consul is a distributed DCS, KV, DNS, and service registry/discovery component.

Pigsty 1.x used Consul as its high-availability DCS. The current open-source tree no longer includes the Consul role, playbook, or consul_* parameters. You cannot use the inventory from older versions to deploy Consul. Current Pigsty DCS integration is provided by the ETCD module.
